title: Mushroom Cat Scratching Post 11inch  For Kitten & Small Cats, Mini Cat Tree Stable Base, Natural Sisal Scratcher With Hanging Ball, Space Saving Indoor Cat Toy For Small Spaces And Apartments
body_html:
• PROTECTS YOUR FURNITURE Cats instinctively scratch to stretch and sharpen their claws. This scratching post provides a dedicated place to scratch, helping keep sofas, chairs, and curtains safe from damage.
  • NATURAL SISAL FOR HEALTHY CLAWS Wrapped with durable natural sisal rope, the post offers a textured surface that satisfies your cat’s natural scratching instinct while supporting healthy claw care.
  • STABLE BASE FOR SAFE PLAY The reinforced base keeps the scratching post balanced when cats jump, stretch, or scratch, reducing wobbling and making everyday play safer.
  • FUN MUSHROOM DESIGN CATS LOVE The playful mushroom-shaped top attracts curiosity and encourages interaction, turning the scratching post into both a cat toy and a decorative piece for your home.
  • PERFECT FOR KITTENS & SMALL SPACES Height: 11 in | Base: 7 in, this mini cat tree is ideal for kittens and small indoor cats. Its compact size fits easily beside sofas, desks, or corners in apartments and bedrooms.
